title: Authors Document (per-paper authors.yaml)
description:
Per-paper authors.yaml document model (GC-2026-1112-06 corrected design, control-board ruling 2026-11-13).

This schema validates the ENTIRE authors.yaml DOCUMENT (a mapping), not a single author entry: the affiliations registry is declared ONCE at document level and every author entry links its units via affiliation_ids. A registry per author entry is a design defect (drift); document-level is the contract.

BARE-LIST FORMAT DEPRECATED (作废): the legacy top-level `- id: ...` array (P1/P2/P3 style) is no longer a valid document shape — this schema is type object + required authors, so a bare list fails validation. The migration phase (phase 3) normalizes all seven papers to the container: schema_version + affiliations (registry, one copy) + authors (byline-ordered list).

Author-2 migration notes (normalize during phase 3):
  - some current files use `author_id` on entries — the registry key is `id` (paper.yaml authors[].author_id joins to this `id`);
  - `roles` is NOT part of the registry model — per the GC-2026-1112-06 division of labor, order/roles/display name live in paper.yaml.authors, the registry carries identity/affiliation numbering/bio;
  - legacy entry `postal_code` is deprecated — migrate into affiliations[].postcode (unit line) and/or bio.postcode (bio).

CROSS-LEVEL REFERENCE (not schema-expressible): [affiliation_ids must resolve to a same-document affiliations registry entry by id] is a cross-level constraint that JSON Schema cannot express. It is ENFORCED BY A BUILD-TIME CHECK (phase 2, tools/paper.py): any dangling affiliation_ids value fails the build. A document that uses affiliation_ids must therefore also carry the affiliations registry.

name_en on every registry item is REQUIRED (venue S5 Chinese/English pair): the English byline and affiliation-number list are generated from it — missing name_en fails the English front-matter build.

schema_version.description: Format version of this authors.yaml document (optional; current files carry schema_version: 1)

affiliations.description: Unit registry, ONE copy for the whole document (design ruling 2026-11-13: never per-entry). Each item: {id, name, name_en} required; city / postcode optional. id must be unique across the registry (build-time check). An EMPTY array is a valid FRESH state — the `init` skeleton starts with affiliations: [] and the semantic gate (validate_metadata) fails the build/check with field-level messages until units are registered (GC-2026-1112-06 final-review rework, P1-1).

id.description: Registry key referenced by author affiliation_ids

name.description: Unit name in Chinese — full name including first-level and second-level unit (venue S2: 一级+二级单位全称)

name_en.description: Unit name in English — REQUIRED per venue S5 (中英成对); the English byline/affiliation line is generated from it. Missing name_en fails the build.

city.description: City in the unit line, e.g. 海口 (rendered '…，海口 570208' per journal-measured template)

city_en.description: City name for the ENGLISH unit line (pinyin transliteration, e.g. 昆明 → Kunming). REQUIRED deviation fix GC-2026-1112-06 收尾: the English affiliation list '1. <name_en>, <city> <postcode>, China' must carry the romanized city (范本 'Haikou 570208, China'), not the Chinese city. When missing, the English line falls back to the Chinese `city` (旧行为，保兼容).

authors.description: Author entries, in BYLINE ORDER (首页/文末按此顺序署名). Cross-reference rule: each affiliation_ids value must resolve to a document-level affiliations registry id — enforced by the build-time check (phase 2), not this schema.

id.description: Lowercase author key; paper.yaml authors[].author_id joins to this id (reference key across paper.yaml / authors.yaml)

name_en.description: Name in English / romanized (English byline, venue S5 bilingual pairing)

affiliation_ids.description: Unit ids referencing the document-level affiliations registry; drives the superscript unit numbers of the byline and the affiliation-number list (journal-measured template). Resolution is a build-time check (phase 2); a dangling id fails the build. An EMPTY array is a valid FRESH state (`init` skeleton); the semantic log gate (validate_metadata) fails the build/check until at least one unit is registered (GC-2026-1112-06 final-review rework, P1-1).

bio.description: Author bio fields (venue S17; key names snake_case English, Chinese S17 field noted per key). All ten required: S17 lists all and the journal-measured template prints the full set for the first author. hometown (籍贯) required — appears in S17 and in the measured template bio ('陕西安康人'). The '单位' segment of the printed bio is NOT a bio key; it is resolved from affiliation_ids via the registry at generation time. Each field ALSO accepts null to represent the `init` skeleton's fresh state (GC-2026-1112-06 final-review rework, P1-1): an unset/null field still validates structurally, and the semantic gate (validate_metadata) then fails the build/check naming the missing field(s). A submission-ready paper must have all ten non-null.

anyOf.description: 出生年；rendered as '1984 年生' (journal-measured template)

birth_year.description: 出生年；rendered as '1984 年生' (journal-measured template). null = init skeleton placeholder.

gender.description: 性别（男/女）。null = init skeleton placeholder.

anyOf.description: 籍贯，e.g. 陕西安康（journal-measured '…，男，陕西安康人，…'）

hometown.description: 籍贯，e.g. 陕西安康（journal-measured '…，男，陕西安康人，…'）。null = init skeleton placeholder.

degree.description: 学位，e.g. 工学博士。null = init skeleton placeholder.

title.description: 职称，e.g. 研究员。null = init skeleton placeholder.

anyOf.description: 研究方向，e.g. 人工智能、大数据、智能系统

research_direction.description: 研究方向，e.g. 人工智能、大数据、智能系统。null = init skeleton placeholder.

address.description: 通信地址。null = init skeleton placeholder.

postcode.description: 邮政编码。null = init skeleton placeholder.

anyOf.description: 电子邮箱（bio 内 S17 字段）

email.description: 电子邮箱（bio 内 S17 字段）。null = init skeleton placeholder.

anyOf.description: 电话（journal-measured plain text, e.g. <电话已脱敏>）

phone.description: 电话（journal-measured plain text, e.g. <电话已脱敏>）。null = init skeleton placeholder.

git_name.description: Git commit identity name (if different from paper name)

git_email.description: Git commit identity email (private noreply preferred)

affiliations.description: LEGACY free-text unit strings (pre-GC-2026-1112-06). Kept OPTIONAL for compatibility; the new model uses document-level affiliations + affiliation_ids, and the generator prefers affiliation_ids.
